lines.t: Beloved, there is a language of which you know nothing about, says the Lord.
A language which is pure and beautiful.
A language in need of no words at all
A language which you shall soon come to know
A language which I have revealed to my servant already
A language of power and great glory
In which all my servants shall come to stand
Received in the presence of the Almighty
mighty, the holiest of holies, revealing the essence of who I am, union in the spirit of
A place beyond time and space, beyond the knowledge, contained within creation, surpassing
The place where I am and have always been seated, where you shall be also a place without
The eternal, the bosom of the Father, of which I am, says the Lord Yahushua.
